symptom: Belt moving, but tread rollers not turning.

causes.cause: Not enough pressure against belt from pressure rollers.
actions: Tighten spring tension on pressure rollers in area of stalled rollers. See “Minimum Pressure Adjustment” in Operation section of this manual.

causes.cause: Bolt in the pressure roller suspension angle binding will not allow adjustment of pressure rollers.
actions: Loosen bolt and adjust spring tension as required. Check for burs or foreign material behind angles.

causes.cause: Missing or broken springs or adjustment nuts.
